name: Date (Fukushima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Date city emblem in blue and yellow: a blue ring open at the top with a yellow curved stroke rising to the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Date, a city in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 January 2006; the emblem dates from 26 March 2006.

features.role: Date city emblem — a blue ring open at the top with a yellow curved stroke rising to the fly
